bio: Chinese dragon heads and lanterns, Japanese sake boxes, photos of owners Jonnie and Thérèse Boer taken during their travels across Asia: this colourful restaurant embodies a melting pot of impressions, and that certainly goes for the food, too. The menu features dishes that are full of flavour and fresh nuances from the Near, Middle and Far East. Chicken yakitori, ceviche, ramen, wonton… This is a truly wonderful culinary adventure. Be sure to try out the generous Senang Table!...
